rapport_notes: Friendly, patient tone; handled customer interruptions and delays well; used customer's name; built genuine conversational flow.
process_discipline_notes: Rep did not hold silence after 'does that feel fair' — no explicit pause or silence confirmation captured after open-ended questions.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: I'm gonna have you know just a few questions to get us on the right track and then that should take about five to ten minutes or so and then I'd be able to get you an accurate quote
evidence_quotes.agenda: What are the biggest concerns or any particular important questions that you want answer to join this call today?
evidence_quotes.agenda_timing_issue: Agenda asked after date/availability probing had already started
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep_gap: Customer raised assembly concern and marble lamp concern; rep acknowledged but pivoted quickly without deep follow-up — 'that's all part of our hourly rate' and 'just let them know' without 'tell me more' or second layer
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: Dry sink — 'just needs to be handled with care' — rep acknowledged; marble lamp — 'it's marble and it's old' — rep said 'just pointed out to them' and will wrap it
evidence_quotes.communication_covered: Few days before the move we'll introduce you to the movers and then the guys will give you a call on the day of to give you an accurate ETA
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: For this week, I would just budget like a six to eight hour day. For example, if only took the guys six hours. The cost of that would be $1,467 in case it would actually take us eight hours. It's gonna be $1,851
evidence_quotes.estimate_personalized: Since you have two beds assembled that need to get reassembled and they have them in pieces... that would just add a little bit more time
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: We have a minimum of two and a half hours and then we would just bill you every fifteen minutes after that
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: If you need us to tape up some boxes that would be fine. It would just go towards the hour rate and since you already bought the tape we're definitely gonna use those
evidence_quotes.close_explicit_ask: I can definitely get you scheduled right now for September 20th Sunday
evidence_quotes.close_rate_lock_missing: No explicit mention of 'rate locks when you book' or rate-lock language

top_strength: Jules expertly gathered detailed logistics (storage unit size, apartment dimensions, furniture condition, special handling needs) while maintaining a warm, patient rapport; he personalized the estimate by anchoring to a typical range and adjusting for the customer's specific reassembly work.
coaching_note: Strengthen Stage 1 by digging two layers deep on each customer concern (ask 'tell me more' or 'what else') rather than acknowledging and moving on; also missing the On-Time Guarantee differentiator entirely and never mentioning rate-lock at close — both are Stage 2/3 takeaway items that should have landed in this call.
